$comment: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE. Lumen Deck is an invented tabletop game and Harrow & Vine is an invented studio. Every number, name, and rate below was made up to demonstrate the schema. Do not treat any of it as guidance on pricing or fee structures.

campaign.headline: A 54-card deck that plays four different games depending on how you deal it
campaign.subhead: One box, four rulebooks, no expansions ever.

capabilities.summary: The same 54 cards support four complete rulesets, printed as four separate saddle-stitched booklets.
One of the four rulesets is a solo scenario ladder with twelve fixed layouts.
Suits are distinguished by shape and edge notch as well as colour, so the deck reads without colour discrimination.
Each booklet opens with a one-page teach spread that gets a new table playing without reading the rest.

roadmap.summary: Linen card finish, contingent on the second stretch band.
A fifth ruleset as a free download after fulfilment, if playtesting supports it.

tiers.label: Print and Play
includes: Card sheets sized for A4 and US Letter

tiers.label: Playtest Credit
includes: Name in the playtester list inside every booklet
Access to the pre-fulfilment rules forum

prohibitions: Do not describe the studio as award-winning; it has not entered any award.
Do not name any playtester without their written note in sources/permissions/.
Do not imply a retail distribution deal exists.

toolDisclosure.location: Credits panel at the foot of the funding page and the last page of each rulebook.

blockers: Card art licence scope does not yet cover paid advertising.
The 'four games' phrasing needs a claim row with a written ruleset count check.
Freight quote is verbal; no written quote archived under sources/.
